content.transliteration: Varṇānām artha saṅghānāṁ rasānāṁ chhandasām api
content.meaning: I bow to Saraswati and Ganesh, the originators of language and meaning.

content.shloka: Bhavani Shankarau Vande Shraddha Vishwas Roopinam
content.transliteration: Bhavānī Śaṅkarau vande śraddhā viśvāsa rūpiṇau
content.meaning: I worship Parvati and Shankar, embodiments of faith and devotion.
